description: This file defines the ExternalEventProducer interface within the Fineract project. It declares a method for sending external events, which takes a map of event partitions and may throw an acknowledgement timeout exception.

classes.name: ExternalEventProducer
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for producing and sending external events within the system.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Sends the created external events partitioned by a map of long identifiers to lists of serialized byte arrays. May throw an AcknowledgementTimeoutException if acknowledgment is not received in time.
